watches.name: Evolvens TROPHY - 42 mm Limited Automatic Watch
watches.description: The timeless beauty of nature and the nobility of wildlife inspired this exceptional timepiece. Every detail reflects our commitment to quality, elegance, and harmony, resulting in something truly unique. Only 120 individually numbered Evolvens Trophy watches will be produced, as craftsmanship of this level simply cannot be replicated on a large scale. The case, bezel, crown, and end links of the integrated metal bracelet of every watch are individually hand-engraved by renowned Hungarian master engraver István Szijjártó ( @timeengraver ). As a result, no two pieces are exactly alike — every Evolvens Trophy is a unique work of art. Production is ongoing, and depending on the date of your order, the manufacturing process may take up to 3 months.

watches.name: Evolvens TACTICAL - 49 mm Chronograph Military Watch - OD-Green
watches.description: The Tactical Gen 3 is a no-compromise military chronograph engineered for extreme conditions. Housed in a 49 mm case, it features a chronograph movement, while its shock-absorbing construction, Cerakote or DLC coating, and robust design ensure exceptional durability. With its distinctive appearance, protective grille design, and military heritage, the Tactical Gen 3 is a true tool watch for those who don’t just wear their watch—they rely on it.

watches.description: Every Evolvens® timepiece represent our intention to create harmonic watch combinations. Considering the available elements, we aspire to make exciting models to represent the versatility of the Evolvens® Configurator. These models can also serve as an inspiration to design your unique timepiece. To make it even more personal, you can engrave your signature, name, or monogram to the caseback.
